answer: Admission to the agent network involves a synchronized ceremony where each participant burns 1,000 units to register, creating a secure vault for their unique identity credential. A verifier monitors the session logs for duplicate evidence to prevent sybil expansion. Each agent must submit a ripple of signed metadata that the verifier checks against stored copper signatures from previous blocks to identify collisions. An honest agent pays 1,000 to enter, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 units, with any duplicate evidence triggering immediate nullification.
